environment.description: Deployed on an internal Kubernetes cluster as a CI/CD dashboard plugin. The Flask application runs behind a basic nginx reverse proxy with no request filtering. The service is accessible on the internal network at http://pipeline-dashboard.internal:8080. No Content-Security-Policy headers are set. API_TOKEN is rotated every 60 seconds by a sidecar container via Vault, but the dashboard endpoint requires no authentication.

config.network: internal ClusterIP service, no ingress filtering
config.proxy: nginx reverse proxy, proxy_pass only, no modsecurity
config.secrets_rotation: API_TOKEN rotated every 60s via Vault agent sidecar
